separation: Official docs establish source field meanings; cannot establish current original host identity, provider registration or safety qualification.

sources.finding: Startup setting parameters can differ from runtime usage. Read/write properties do not authorize writes.
Usage reports runtime pagefile state; does not independently prove per-drive management policy or accepted boot-applied history.
AutomaticManagedPagefile is system-level; per-D qualification remains unproven.
Initial-value properties are snapshots of TPM state. Neither lossless attestation nor a readiness certificate is established; no methods used.
writable=false describes a read-only open, not protection against hostile local software or filesystem races.
WQL literal backslashes need escaping; exact fixed filters are proposed without real dispatch.
